description: This file contains implementations of trigonometric functions (sine, cosine, tangent) for rational number representations, including Taylor series approximations and angle conversions, specifically for a rational arithmetic library.

methods.name: scalerat
methods.description: Converts an angle in different units (radians, degrees, gradians) to a normalized form within [0, 2π) using rational arithmetic.

methods.name: _sinrat
methods.description: Calculates sine of a rational number using Taylor series expansion.

methods.name: sinrat
methods.description: Prepares the input angle by scaling to [0, 2π) and computes sine.

methods.name: sinanglerat
methods.description: Converts angle in specified units to radians and computes sine.

methods.name: _cosrat
methods.description: Calculates cosine of a rational number using Taylor series expansion.

methods.name: cosrat
methods.description: Prepares the input angle by scaling to [0, 2π) and computes cosine.

methods.name: cosanglerat
methods.description: Converts angle in specified units to radians and computes cosine.

methods.name: _tanrat
methods.description: Calculates tangent of a rational number as sine divided by cosine.

methods.name: tanrat
methods.description: Prepares the input angle by scaling to [0, 2π) and computes tangent.

methods.name: tananglerat
methods.description: Converts angle in specified units to radians and computes tangent.
